props.name: tableName
props._description: Name of the data table this grid reads and writes.

props.name: primaryKey
props._description: Column that uniquely identifies a row. Used for selection, update and delete.

props.name: parentTableName
props._description: Parent table this grid is a detail of, for master-detail screens. Empty for a standalone table.

props.name: parentTablePrimaryKey
props._description: Column in this table holding the parent row's key — the foreign key side of the master-detail link.

props.name: tableSettings
props._description: Shows the settings control that lets the user show, hide and reorder columns.

props.name: tableSorting
props._description: Lets the user sort by clicking column headers.

props.name: tableSelection
props._description: Shows the row selection checkboxes. On by default.

props.name: tableActions
props._description: Shows the per-row action controls (add, edit, delete).

props.name: needLocking
props._description: Locks a row while it is being edited so two users cannot change it at once. (?)

props.name: isPivotTable
props._description: Renders the same data as a pivot grid instead of a flat table.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.
